subject: CS477
filterSummary: Selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos covering key compiler design topics. The English selection features highly-viewed, conceptually clear videos from established educational channels. The Arabic selection provides solid coverage with in-depth lectures, though one topic, 'Implementing Type Checking', had no eligible candidates due to a lack of relevant, high-quality content.

coverage.note: All candidates were either irrelevant (R<6), focusing on language features instead of compiler implementation, or had too few views.

videos.title: Lec-20: S-Attributed vs L-Attributed SDT | Types of SDT
videos.filter_reason: A very popular and clear explanation of S-Attributed vs L-Attributed definitions, which is a core concept of attribute grammars.

videos.title: Building a Typechecker from scratch [1/20] Introduction to Type theory and checking
videos.filter_reason: A practical guide that walks through building a type checker from scratch, perfectly matching the topic's implementation focus.

videos.title: Symbol Table
videos.filter_reason: An excellent and highly-viewed introduction from a reputable channel that covers the purpose, entries, and operations of a symbol table.

videos.title: Namespaces in C++
videos.filter_reason: Clearly explains namespaces in C++, a fundamental mechanism for name resolution and scoping, with high production quality.

videos.title: Phases of Compiler | Syntax & Semantic | Part -2/3 | CD | Compiler Design | Lec-03 |  Bhanu Priya
videos.filter_reason: This popular video clearly explains the role of semantic analysis in the context of the compiler phases, providing a strong foundational understanding.

videos.title: مترجمات/المرحلة الثالثةThe Role of the Lexical Analyzer  وكذلك  تصميم  ال  Symbol Table
videos.filter_reason: One of the few Arabic videos that specifically focuses on the design of the symbol table and passes the view count threshold.

videos.title: #8 Semantic Analysis || Compilers for Computer Science
videos.filter_reason: A comprehensive, in-depth lecture covering the entire semantic analysis phase, including its various sub-tasks like scoping and type checking.

videos.title: Semantic Analysis intro (Attribute Grammar) ISSR CS510 (Arabic)
videos.filter_reason: This is a dedicated lecture on attribute grammars, making it highly relevant and one of the few comprehensive Arabic resources on the topic.

videos.title: Dynamic scoping vs Static scoping in Arabic
videos.filter_reason: Directly explains the core concepts of static vs. dynamic scoping, which are fundamental to name resolution in compilers.
